purpose: Enable sourced balm-finish previews for six existing Coupang products. Replace each matching preview object, do not merge its old unavailableReason.

rendererContract.opacity: 0..1; strength of tinted pigment at normal camera-engine opacity. Clear balm has zero pigment.
rendererContract.glossStrength: 0..0.3; small face-tracked highlights inside outer lip minus inner-mouth opening.
rendererContract.clearBalm: Do not require color, call estimateLipColor, or multiply a synthetic white/neutral colour across lips. Preserve natural lip colour.
rendererContract.tintedBalm: Use supplied color with low opacity and preserve lip texture. Colors are explicitly illustrative, not sampled from package caps.
rendererContract.disclosure: Use shadeLabel in the short preview chip. The longer previewNote belongs in detail/help, not a blocking message.
